value.rationale: The theorem resolves a natural restricted reconstruction problem at the first run-complexity threshold admitting collisions: every four-run fiber is classified for arbitrary length and composition, and maximum distinct-deck code size reduces to a precise multiplication-table overlap invariant. The unbounded-fiber construction proves a genuine structural vulnerability of the gapped readout even at constant run complexity. This is not merely the already published length-six collision or an arbitrary finite sample.
